scope_limits: No new Godot import, render, animation execution or performance test was run for this baseline record.
R6 studio images establish historical shape/material observations. R7 changes are bounded by the existing independently reviewed weight-only audit; actual R7 native frames are included.
Five stills do not establish continuous animation, dynamic facial expression, day/night coverage or gameplay feel.
Prior release tests and captured footage retain their existing bounded acceptance; they do not pass the new production-art gate.
No Deadlock or Overwatch client executable/assets were inspected; no parity measured.
Physical-GPU performance, Windows execution and online authority remain UNRUN/OPEN.
